∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : DecidableEq ι] [inst_1 : Fintype ι] (𝒞 : Finset (Finset ι)),
  HiddenChannelCapacity.Acyclic 𝒞 ↔
    ∀ (fam : List (HiddenChannelCapacity.LocalStruct ι fun x => ZMod 2)),
      List.map (fun x => x.team) fam = 𝒞.toList →
        HiddenChannelCapacity.Consistent fam → (∀ L ∈ fam, L.rel.Nonempty) → HiddenChannelCapacity.Glues fam
